titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kaisou Toshi Danpenshuu
synopsis: In a world approaching its end, humanity has built a colossal, multi-layered city that rises high into the sky through the power of advanced technology. As the city continues to expand, its inhabitants live their lives within and around the vast structure, creating new connections and leaving behind the fruits of human endeavor. Spanning different eras in this dying world, the story presents a series of snapshots that capture the lives, hopes, and everyday experiences of the people who inhabit the towering metropolis—a record of humanity and the traces it leaves behind. title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)
